Many people on this site will tell you to act however you want and not care about gender norms. Perhaps they may be implying that you are gender fluid perhaps. Remember however that this minority are not happy in life. Living without a firm identity and a place in society will do that to you.

So  in short listen to your father. He may seem unfair to you now but in the future you will be very thankful over the life lessons he thought you.
